tips.text: Free two Companion slots before claiming; one holds Dethcube Prime and one its Deth Machine Rifle Prime.
Buy extra Blueprint and Cerebrum relics from Varzia; both are Rare parts.
Bank Aya before her window opens; it never expires.
Refine Rare and Uncommon relics to Radiant and leave Common relics Intact; Radiant lowers their Common odds.
Join a Radiant radshare squad when you crack the Rare relics.
Pick a teammate's identical reward on the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
